description:
DuckDB ClickBench SF 1.0 failed during load in the UAT sweep with
`NOT NULL constraint failed: hits.Referer`
(`duckdb_clickbench_1.0_20260502_164814.log:10`). The load then halted with
empty `hits`, making the cell unusable for Explorer coverage.

preserves.behavior: ClickBench schema compatibility for other platforms is not regressed.
DuckDB load errors continue to surface exact constraint context.

verifications.command: BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs uv run -- benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark clickbench --scale 1.0 --phases load,power --non-interactive
verifications.description: DuckDB ClickBench SF1 load/power smoke reaches a classified terminal result.
verifications.expected: completed result or explicit classified corpus/schema failure

work_units.notes:
UAT log evidence: `/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_20260502/duckdb_clickbench_1.0_20260502_164814.log`
reused `/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/datagen/clickbench_sf1/hits.csv.zst`, then failed bulk load with
`NOT NULL constraint failed: hits.Referer`.

The ClickBench contract allows empty Referer strings, not NULLs: `Referer` is column 14 in
`benchbox/core/clickbench/schema.py`, is `TEXT NOT NULL`, and Q29 filters `Referer <> ''`. The generator
intentionally emits empty referers, and the SF1 corpus contains an empty field in column 14. The ClickBench benchmark
advertises pipe-delimited CSV with `csv_null_marker: None` in the manifest and `nullstr='__NULL__'` in
`get_csv_loading_config()` to preserve empty strings.

The DuckDB handler factory resolves the CSV dialect but passes only `dialect.delimiter` into
`DuckDBNativeHandler`. `DuckDBNativeHandler` then hardcodes `nullstr=''` on pipe-delimited `read_csv` branches in
`benchbox/platforms/base/data_loading.py`, so DuckDB converts empty Referer fields to NULL before enforcing the
NOT NULL schema constraint. W2 should fix the loader null-marker propagation rather than changing the ClickBench
schema or mutating the reusable corpus.

Cleanup boundary: this work item did not create loaded database artifacts. Subsequent load/power verification should
preserve reusable source data under `/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/datagen/` and remove only run-owned loaded
database/output artifacts created by this TODO after they are no longer needed. Do not delete reusable TPC-H datagen
corpora, because read primitives and related benchmarks reuse them.
work_units.summary: Trace ClickBench schema/data nullability for DuckDB

work_units.notes:
Implemented the loader fix instead of classifying the corpus invalid. DuckDB handler construction now passes the
resolved CSV `null_marker` into `DuckDBNativeHandler`. Pipe-delimited DuckDB native loads use `nullstr=''` when
the dialect says empty fields are NULL, and use the shared `__NULL__` sentinel when `null_marker` is `None` so
empty ClickBench fields remain empty strings. The same sentinel handling was applied to DuckDB external text scans
so `CsvDialect.null_marker=None` has one meaning across DuckDB read paths.

W2 review found and fixed the external-scan gap; no remaining actionable W2 review issues. Verification passed:
targeted ruff, ruff format --check, ty check (with the existing optional `vortex` unresolved-import diagnostic),
`tests/unit/platforms/base/test_trailing_delimiter_loading.py`, `tests/unit/platforms/test_duckdb_operations.py`,
`tests/unit/test_clickbench_csv_loading.py`, the shared-root DuckDB ClickBench SF1 load/power smoke, and the
10-worker fast suite. The smoke produced result JSON
`/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/results/clickbench_sf1_duckdb_sql_20260503_030728_b19d7d6d.json`.
Run-owned loaded database artifacts under `/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/databases/clickbench_sf1` were
deleted after verification; reusable datagen was preserved.
work_units.summary: Fix the loader/schema mismatch or classify the corpus as invalid

work_units.notes:
Added targeted regression coverage in `tests/unit/test_clickbench_csv_loading.py`: an in-memory DuckDB native pipe
load verifies an empty ClickBench `Referer` field survives insertion into a NOT NULL table as `''`, and an external
scan SQL test verifies `csv_null_marker: None` emits the no-null-conversion sentinel instead of DuckDB's default
empty-string null marker.

W3 review found no actionable issues. Verification passed: ruff, ruff format --check, ty check, targeted
`tests/unit/test_clickbench_csv_loading.py`, shared-root DuckDB ClickBench SF1 load/power smoke, and the 10-worker
fast suite. The smoke produced result JSON
`/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/results/clickbench_sf1_duckdb_sql_20260503_031240_722b7b76.json`.
Run-owned loaded database artifacts under `/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/databases/clickbench_sf1` were
deleted after verification; reusable datagen was preserved.
